parent.title: Self-hosted YouTube archivers: web UI, channel watching, and liked-video sync (2026)

siblings.title: Core candidates survey
siblings.summary: Six self-hosted YouTube tools compared on web UI, channel watching, and liked-video sync — TubeArchivist vs PinchFlat is the real decision.

siblings.title: Channel watching and new-upload automation
siblings.summary: How PinchFlat, TubeArchivist, ytdl-sub, TubeSync and MeTube watch channels for new uploads — scheduling models, download filters, the RSS-vs-yt-dlp detection layer, and 2026 throttle/ban etiquette.
